skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts related to cloud computing architecture.
Design secure architectures for cloud computing systems.
Isolate physical and logical infrastructure for security purposes.
Implement comprehensive data protection strategies across all OSI layers.
Manage access control mechanisms for cloud-based services.
Set up monitoring, auditing, and management processes for cloud services.
Implement identity management solutions within cloud environments.
Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.
